subject: Request: one-time PLG onboarding credit for AcmeCorp POC

Subject: PLG signup — one-off onboarding credit request for AcmeCorp POC

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. We’re lining up a short POC ahead of our internal executive review on Jan 27 and would like to provision a bit more runway on the PLG trial so our engineers have headroom to validate the integration.

Can Redwood issue a one-time promo code we can apply to our signup that grants roughly $2k worth of usage (or equivalent tokens) and a 90-day window? That should cover a couple of synthetic workloads and a small scale load test. I attached a short POC summary and expected usage snapshot.

- POC owners: Jen Sullivan (app), Miguel Ramos (infra)
- Key ask: one promo code that the signup user can enter OR an account-level credit we can apply from procurement
- Timeline: need code by EOD Jan 22 if possible (demo Jan 26)

Attachments: acmecorp-poc-summary.pdf (pdf), acme-usage-snapshot.csv (csv)

Best,
Jen Sullivan
Sr. Platform Engineer, AcmeCorp
jen.sullivan@acmecorp.com

Jen — thanks for the details and the attachments. I’ve looped Ben and Connor to confirm approval and generate the code. A couple quick clarifying Qs before we proceed:

1) Would you prefer a coupon that the signup user redeems during self-serve signup, or an account-level credit that our sales/ops team applies after registration?
2) Do you anticipate sustained monthly usage beyond the POC? That affects whether we encourage a short extension vs a larger one-off credit.

If you can reply with your preference, we’ll expedite. Ben — can you confirm if a $2k one-off credit aligns with current promo policy for PLG accounts? Marissa — FYI on the asks.

Thanks,

Sr. Growth Ops, Redwood Inference
